description: This file defines a test double class FakeCalendarSyncJobFactory used for unit testing. It simulates the behavior of CalendarSyncJobFactory by avoiding database interactions, providing in-memory storage for created jobs, and enabling controlled testing of calendar sync job creation without side effects.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncJobFactory
classes.description: A test double class emulating CalendarSyncJobFactory for unit tests, with methods to create jobs, track calls, and manage a fake scheduler.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the fake scheduler object or null.

methods.name: setFakeScheduler
methods.description: Sets the fake scheduler instance used by the factory.

methods.name: createAccountJob
methods.description: Creates a fake account job ID for a given calendar account ID, tracking creation in-memory.

methods.name: createMeetingJob
methods.description: Creates a fake meeting job ID based on a CalendarSyncOperation object, tracking creation in-memory.

methods.name: getCreatedAccountJobs
methods.description: Returns the list of all created account jobs.

methods.name: getCreatedMeetingJobs
methods.description: Returns the list of all created meeting jobs.

methods.name: wasAccountJobCreated
methods.description: Checks if any account job was created during the test.

methods.name: wasMeetingJobCreated
methods.description: Checks if any meeting job was created during the test.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all internal tracking data and the fake scheduler.
